reviewer: Agent A independent explicit-file publication review
scope: Privacy/publication safety of exactly selectedFiles at the recorded SHA256, including preserved failures and scoped NOT_RUN reports. This is not functional acceptance of the whole LMS task.
operation: Read exact selected local files, extract/scans as recorded and write this report only; no staging, commit, database, browser, provider or production operation.

reviewedNonSecretMatches.resolution: Exact JSON authorization field is a plain-language account of user permission, not an HTTP header or credential. Entire actual value read and reviewed; rule remains active for all other paths/values.

visualReview.priorImages: Exact paths already visually reviewed and hash-bound by base/supplement reviews. New COPY PDF is one page, contains explicit synthetic and copy labels; its XLSX is header plus one synthetic row, zero formulas and zero external links.

hardExclusions: Raw credential-bearing first-flow command rejection files; COMMAND_REJECTIONS.json is the sanitized substitute
Raw fixtures, private source ZIP, database/backup/storage contents, session/runtime/worker logs, traces, test-results, error-context and helper .cjs/.cjs.txt
Unselected files in folders that contain selected files; selection never authorizes a recursive folder add
Current full-e2e-20261015-05 command/results/outputs and future canonical acceptance reports; only its stable runtime-start/runtime-source records were already reviewed and selected
historicalLimits: Two nonexistent historical before-measurement paths remain NOT_RUN; no evidence was fabricated.
Synthetic names, UUIDs, non-secret local paths and test hashes in reviewed reports are retained for audit correlation; no real learner personal data or account credentials were identified.
Preserved failed commands remain failures. A selected PASS report proves only its stated scope.

immutability.instruction: Once candidate evidence binds this report, do not rewrite it. Any subsequent file mutation, final full-browser output or final canonical report requires a separate FINAL_PUBLICATION_MANIFEST.json scan. This PASS covers these exact byte versions only.
